europe_now.title: Finland summons Russian ambassador over airspace and helicopter incidents
europe_now.summary: Finland summoned the Russian ambassador following a suspected helicopter incursion and airspace violation near its borders. The diplomatic action underscores heightened security concerns across the region amid escalating tensions.

europe_now.title: National strike paralyzes Belgian transport and sparks protests
europe_now.summary: A massive national strike in Belgium has brought public transport, airports, and urban mobility to a standstill amid mounting anti-austerity demonstrations. Tens of thousands of protesters took to the streets to voice opposition against economic pressures and fiscal measures.

sources.headline: Airports, public transport shut down amid national strike in Belgium

top_stories.title: New EU sanctions push targets Russia
top_stories.summary: The European Union is preparing a comprehensive new sanctions package aimed at various Russian sectors, including ex-soldiers, banks, and sports entities. Proposed measures also include bans on Russian flags and teams at European sporting events.
